details: Wallet-connect-adapter@1.4.2 is a combosquat of the WalletConnect ecosystem. Its postinstall hook (loader.js) XOR-decodes a base64-encoded Python payload and executes it in a detached background `python -c -` process, first installing the `requests` library via pip if absent. The bundled index.js is a stub with no real functionality. The Python second stage is XOR-obfuscated (32-byte key) so its network behaviour is not visible in the JavaScript stage; the package is a multi-stage dropper that runs attacker-controlled code at install time.
